import unittest
from solution import tenant_label


class TenantLabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_lowercased_leftmost_label(self):
        self.assertEqual(tenant_label("https://Tenant.example.com"), "tenant")
        self.assertEqual(tenant_label("https://a-b.service.example.org"), "a-b")

    def test_path_query_and_fragment_do_not_matter(self):
        self.assertEqual(tenant_label("https://Acme.example.com/path/to/x?q=1#part"), "acme")

    def test_requires_at_least_three_labels(self):
        self.assertEqual(tenant_label("https://one.two.three"), "one")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            tenant_label("https://example.com")

    def test_rejects_credentials_and_explicit_ports(self):
        invalid = [
            "https://user@a.example.com",
            "https://user:pass@a.example.com",
            "https://a.example.com:443/path",
        ]
        for url in invalid:
            with self.subTest(url=url):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    tenant_label(url)

    def test_rejects_wrong_or_non_absolute_urls(self):
        invalid = [
            "http://a.example.com",
            "a.example.com/path",
            "/relative/path",
            "https:///missing-host",
            "",
        ]
        for url in invalid:
            with self.subTest(url=url):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    tenant_label(url)

    def test_rejects_invalid_hostname_labels(self):
        invalid = [
            "https://-a.example.com",
            "https://a-.example.com",
            "https://a..example.com",
            "https://a_bad.example.com",
            "https://ténant.example.com",
            "https://a.example.com.",
        ]
        for url in invalid:
            with self.subTest(url=url):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    tenant_label(url)

    def test_non_string_raises_type_error(self):
        for value in (None, 123, b"https://a.example.com"):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    tenant_label(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
